newsitem.title: UK: Royal Bank Scotland to redeem pref shares.
newsitem.headline: Royal Bank Scotland to redeem pref shares.

text.p: The Royal Bank of Scotland said on Monday it would call for the redemption, at a cost of around $200 million, of all of its eight million non-cumulative dollar preference shares issued on September 14, 1989.
Each is represented by an American Depositary Receipt. The shares and the ADRs will be redeemed on October 16 at $25.84 per share, plus accrued and unpaid dividends to the redemption date.

The group said in a statement that it would finance "the susbstantial portion of the redemption price" with the net proceeds of the offer and sale of new non-cumulative dollar preference shares with a nominal value of $0.01 each.
The new series, called Series E, will be issued in the form of American Depository Receipts (ADRs) in the U.S. at a subscription price of $25.0 per share.
They will qualify as Tier One capital and an application has been made to list the ADRs on the New York Stock Exchange but not to list the Series E preference shares on the London Stock Exchange.
